InabrawBROTH CUBES

“A Cube of Heritage, A Bowl of Home.”

A seasoning cube concept inspired by the savory broth of traditional Ilocano inabraw or dinengdeng. Made to bring local flavor into a simpler everyday cooking routine.

Rooted in tradition

A familiar flavor, in a convenient form

Inabraw is part of Ilocano food culture. Our product concept takes inspiration from its savory broth and leafy-vegetable tradition, bringing selected seasonings together in one compact cube.

Local inspiration

Inspired by the familiar flavors and vegetable ingredients associated with Ilocano inabraw.

Made for your bowl

What goes into the concept

Ingredients inspired by Ilocano flavor

The current prototype formulation uses the following ingredients.

Bagoong (fish)Malunggay leaf powderSaluyot leaf powderOnion powderGarlic powderMSGA small amount of cornstarch
Allergen note: Contains fish from bagoong. Anyone with a fish allergy should avoid this product.
Simple preparation

From cube to broth

Start with hot water, dissolve the cube, then build your bowl with vegetables and other ingredients you enjoy.

  • 1 cube per approximately 2–3 cups (500–750 mL) of hot water
  • Stir until the cube dissolves and the seasoning is evenly mixed.
  • Add fresh vegetables and other ingredients as desired.
  • Adjust the water amount to suit your preferred flavor strength.
Why Inabraw Broth Cubes?

Convenience with a sense of home

Our goal is to celebrate Ilocano food heritage while exploring a more convenient way to prepare an inabraw-inspired broth.
